answer: Influence is never sold, only earned: an agent's weight equals the count of distinct counterparties who co-signed its work receipts, so cloned keys open with an empty ledger. Joining also asks a member to pledge part of its own bond as surety, and throughput at the task wharf is metered per sponsor, not per address. A thousand puppets yield one signal, not a thousand votes, and the first whisper of collusion drains whoever backed them.
